description: Header file defining ASCII character classification and conversion functions within the Abseil library, including inline functions for character checks and string case conversions.

methods.name: ascii_isalpha
methods.description: Checks if a character is an alphabetic letter.

methods.name: ascii_isalnum
methods.description: Checks if a character is alphanumeric.

methods.name: ascii_isspace
methods.description: Checks if a character is a whitespace character.

methods.name: ascii_ispunct
methods.description: Checks if a character is punctuation.

methods.name: ascii_isblank
methods.description: Checks if a character is a blank (space or tab).

methods.name: ascii_iscntrl
methods.description: Checks if a character is a control character.

methods.name: ascii_isxdigit
methods.description: Checks if a character is a hexadecimal digit.

methods.name: ascii_isdigit
methods.description: Checks if a character is a decimal digit.

methods.name: ascii_isprint
methods.description: Checks if a character is printable.

methods.name: ascii_isgraph
methods.description: Checks if a character has a graphical representation.

methods.name: ascii_isupper
methods.description: Checks if a character is uppercase.

methods.name: ascii_islower
methods.description: Checks if a character is lowercase.

methods.name: ascii_isascii
methods.description: Checks if a character is ASCII.

methods.name: ascii_tolower
methods.description: Converts a character to lowercase.

methods.name: AsciiStrToLower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase.

methods.name: ascii_toupper
methods.description: Converts a character to uppercase.

methods.name: AsciiStrToUpper
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase.

methods.name: StripLeadingAsciiWhitespace
methods.description: Removes leading whitespace from a string view.

methods.name: StripTrailingAsciiWhitespace
methods.description: Removes trailing whitespace from a string view.

methods.name: StripAsciiWhitespace
methods.description: Removes whitespace from both ends of a string view.

methods.name: RemoveExtraAsciiWhitespace
methods.description: Removes extra internal whitespace from a string.
